# Einhorn Center for Community Engagement

> The Einhorn Center for Community Engagement at Cornell University connects students, faculty, and community partners through service-learning, volunteer opportunities, and civic leadership programs.

The center facilitates meaningful community partnerships and student engagement initiatives while supporting social justice work and leadership development. It serves as Cornell's hub for connecting academic learning with real-world community impact.

## Key Topics

- Community Engagement
- Service-Learning
- Student Opportunities
- Community Partnerships
- Volunteer Programs
- Leadership Development
- Social Justice
- Student Internships
- Community Work-Study
- Faculty Collaboration
- Engaged Opportunity Grants
- Maribel Garcia Community Spirit Award
- Kaplan Family Distinguished Faculty Fellowship
- Student Stories
- Civic Impact

- [Opportunities for Students](https://einhorn.cornell.edu/opportunities-for-students): Student opportunities in community engagement, volunteering, and leadership programs

## Community Partnerships

- [Opportunities for Community Partners](https://einhorn.cornell.edu/opportunities-for-community-partners): Community partnership opportunities with Cornell for service-learning and collaboration
